user.title: Set up Schedule Creator
user.description: Create the local Schedule Creator configuration. No token, YAML or helper is required.

set_profile.name: Set profile
set_profile.description: Activate or deactivate a Schedule Creator profile. Activating an exclusive profile deactivates the other exclusive ones.

active.name: Active
active.description: On to activate, off to deactivate.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: On to enable, off to disable.

start_timer.name: Start Quick Timer
start_timer.description: Command a device for a while; schedules do not interrupt it. At the end the device takes the schedule running then, otherwise what the schedules left, otherwise its previous state. One timer per device.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the timer lasts (up to 7 days).

action.name: Action
action.description: Service of the device domain, e.g. turn_on, or apply_state for a desired state.

data.name: Data
data.description: Service data, e.g. state: cool, temperature: 23 with apply_state.

cancel_timer.name: Cancel Quick Timer
cancel_timer.description: End the running Quick Timer of a device now, exactly as if its time had run out.

resume.name: Resume schedule
resume.description: Give the entities back to their schedules now: a running Quick Timer on them ends, and the running slot sends its command again (for example after a manual change). Does nothing when there is neither.

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: Entities that get the running slot again.
